output.sql:
SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
output.explanation: The query adds up net revenue for each customer segment for 2025 order dates (fiscal year is the calendar year). Following the warehouse definition, it only counts completed orders (is_revenue = true) and leaves out shipping fees. Results are sorted from highest to lowest revenue.
